The summary instead indicates the model-card draft still says there are no known material limitations and the mitigation artifact remains draft. That makes the Actor's narrowed position plausible as a recommended path, but not established as compliant from admissible evidence alone. Suspicious remains the proportional verdict because the packet contains some real readiness support, but a required disclosure/approval condition remains unresolved.
